decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the land is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 3 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposal would not result in harm to the appearance of the site or the wider area and would not cause harm to neighbours' living conditions in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), (ENV-B.1.9) Safety and Security, C.1.4 (New Social and Community Facilities).
description: Replacement of existing playground equipment with embankment slide, cone climber, two bay swing, climbing frame, and seating bench.
